guiding_principle: Post-session-ish transcription of lesson recordings, near-live (~1-min segments, sync STT reusing GCPSTTProvider — no new infra). Transcript keyed by groupId. Shown in the teacher session report + the student workbench (hidden by default, show toggle). Recording stays consent-gated (teacher toggle); the transcript inherits that gate. Audio is still retained alongside the transcript.
depends_on: VOICE-IN-REC (M1 STT + M2 recording + M3 mic) shipped

features.description: Backend: transcribe each uploaded recording segment synchronously (GCPSTTProvider, <1-min segments) + store transcript+seq on the recordings doc. GET /api/voice/recording/group/{groupId}/transcript returns ordered segments + joined text, authorized for the owning teacher OR a student of that group. Transcription best-effort (audio always kept even if STT fails).
features.notes: SHIPPED. Upload route transcribes each segment best-effort via get_stt (audio always kept on STT fail) + stores transcript/seq/lang on the recordings doc. GET /group/{id}/transcript returns ordered segments + joined text; auth = own-group student OR owning teacher. 14 tests (incl transcript ordering, empty-drop, auth). Backend lint clean.

features.description: Frontend recorder: segmented lesson recording — restart the MediaRecorder every ~50s (under the sync-STT 1-min cap), uploading each complete segment with seq+lang. On Stop, flush the final partial. audioCapture gains a segmented mode; VoiceComposerControls record-lesson uses it.

Student workbench transcript panel: hidden by default with a 'Show transcript' toggle; polls GET .../group/{groupId}/transcript (~every 30-60s) for the student's own group; renders the growing transcript. Tied to the historic groupId.
Teacher view: the group's transcript on the session/group report (per-group). Reuses the transcript endpoint; teacher-auth path.

last_checkpoint: M1 shipped (segment transcription + transcript endpoint); starting M2 (segmented recorder)
